verdict.rationale: Atlassian's features page claims you can keep work up to date by tracking progress from tools like Figma via an AI assist, and that Rovo connects Figma assets to Jira work. Automation and 3000+ Marketplace integrations are offered to keep Jira in sync with other tools. However, these are one-line marketing claims with no detail on actually changing issue status from inside the design tool. One community report says a design team found tracking their work in Jira too much effort, which lowers confidence but does not concretely contradict the Figma integration. Missing for 10: documented in-Figma status/transition updates, detail on how the Figma integration works, and independent or hands-on corroboration from designers.
